Standard: The air vehicle has the required agility to perform the intended MTEs with assigned handling qualities no worse than Level 2. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis to assess the assigned HQRs for the MTEs appropriate to the air vehicle's required level of agility (Limited, Moderate, Aggressive, Target Acquisition and Tracking) and category (Attack, Scout, Utility, Cargo) as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Required Agility and Mission Task Elements paragraphs for each air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the assigned HQRs for the MTEs appropriate to the air vehicle's required level of agility (Limited, Moderate, Aggressive, Target Acquisition and Tracking) and category (Attack, Scout, Utility, Cargo) as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Required Agility and Mission Task Elements paragraphs for each air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the assigned HQRs for the MTEs appropriate to the air vehicle's required level of agility (Limited, Moderate, Aggressive, Target Acquisition and Tracking) and category (Attack, Scout, Utility, Cargo) as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Required Agility and Mission Task Elements paragraphs for selected combinations of air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE.
